title: Datasets of an inherited form or data module
summary: repo read-dfm follows a link source, lookup dataset or grid dataset into the DFM of the ancestor form or data module
intro: Read this when repo read-dfm reports a memory table or a lookup as unresolved although its source is a dataset of an inherited data module. The table name, the SQL and the fields of an inherited dataset are in the ancestor's DFM; drag-lint finds the ancestor class in the unit beside the DFM and reads the one DFM of the same folder that has it. What it cannot follow is a warning that names the reason; nothing is picked. AttachTable(X.Table) links to dataset X.

questions.ask: Why is a memory table copied from a dataset of an inherited data module unresolved, and which table does it hold?
Which ancestor DFM did repo read-dfm read a dataset from, and why was an ancestor not followed?
